en: A song of Dovid, when he was in the wilderness of Yehudah:

he: אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ אֵלִ֥י אַתָּ֗ה אֲֽשַׁ֫חֲרֶ֥ךָּ צָמְאָ֬ה לְךָ֨ ׀ נַפְשִׁ֗י כָּמַ֣הּ לְךָ֣ בְשָׂרִ֑י בְּאֶרֶץ־צִיָּ֖ה וְעָיֵ֣ף בְּלִי־מָֽיִם׃
en: Elokim, my Keil are You; I shall seek You early; my soul thirsts for You, my flesh longs for You, in a dry and weary land, without water.

he: כֵּ֭ן בַּקֹּ֣דֶשׁ חֲזִיתִ֑ךָ לִרְא֥וֹת עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ וּכְבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
en: So in the Sanctuary I have beheld You, to see Your might and Your glory.
For Your kindness is better than life; my lips shall praise You.
So I shall bless You in my life; in Your name I shall lift my hands.

he: כְּמ֤וֹ חֵ֣לֶב וָ֭דֶשֶׁן תִּשְׂבַּ֣ע נַפְשִׁ֑י וְשִׂפְתֵ֥י רְ֝נָנ֗וֹת יְהַלֶּל־פִּֽי׃
en: As with fat and marrow my soul shall be satisfied, and with lips of song my mouth shall praise.
If I remember You upon my bed, in the watches of the night I shall meditate on You.

he: כִּֽי־הָיִ֣יתָ עֶזְרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י וּבְצֵ֖ל כְּנָפֶ֣יךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן׃
en: For You have been a help to me, and in the shadow of Your wings I shall sing.

he: דָּבְקָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֣י אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ בִּ֝֗י תָּמְכָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
en: My soul cleaves after You; Your right hand upholds me.

he: וְהֵ֗מָּה לְ֭שׁוֹאָה יְבַקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י יָ֝בֹ֗אוּ בְּֽתַחְתִּיּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
en: And they who seek my soul for destruction — they shall come into the lowest parts of the earth.
They shall be delivered to the power of the sword; they shall be a portion for foxes.

he: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ֮ יִשְׂמַ֢ח בֵּאלֹ֫הִ֥ים יִ֭תְהַלֵּל כׇּל־הַנִּשְׁבָּ֣ע בּ֑וֹ כִּ֥י יִ֝סָּכֵ֗ר פִּ֣י דוֹבְרֵי־שָֽׁקֶר׃ {פ}
en: And the king shall rejoice in Elokim; all who swear by Him shall glory, for the mouth of speakers of falsehood shall be stopped. [an open section break]
